resources.string: HeadSwap — dismiss keyboard on head unit

Tap outside a text field to hide the keyboard on your head unit. HeadSwap checks window and text field positions on its own virtual display. Typed text is never read or saved. You can disable the feature here.
Hide keyboard when tapping outside a text field
To use this feature, enable “HeadSwap — dismiss keyboard on head unit” in Android accessibility settings. The hardware Back button also works without this service.
